Fed pricing arithmetic/provenance: independently retrieved September 10 ZQU26 96.2874984741211 and NY Fed EFFR 3.63% effective September 9. With 16 pre-change and 14 post-change days, post=(30*(100-price)-16*3.63)/14 is 3.806788984%, matching implied_rate_after at six decimals. Adjacent 3.63% hold and 3.88% hike interpolation gives 70.71559361%, rounded hike/hold 71%/29%; sensitivity is 8.57142857 percentage points per contract basis point. The day split assumes a September 17 effective policy change. Zero cut is a two-leg model restriction, not a measured zero real-world probability. Source, proxy text and FOMC calendar consistently say Yahoo daily close, not certified CME settlement. Session September 10 and actual September 11 collection time are explicit. The preserved 602-byte blocked CME body supports the direct-distribution-unavailable note.

Midpoint 97.6125 implies 2.3875%, while the distinct settlement implies 2.3900%. The official CRA specification describes a compounded quarterly CORRA rate from the reference month's third Wednesday to the delivery month's third Wednesday; December's IMM boundary is December 16, with trading terminating the preceding business day. October 28 and December 9 both fall in this reference quarter, so October weights are not identified.
